item.title: D2 BASKETBALL: Lehman sets up rematch with Holy Redeemer
item.description: The Lake-Lehman girls basketball team is heading back to the District 2 Class 3A semifinals to face off with a familiar opponent. The Black Knights used an 11-5 advantage in the third quarter to build on a three-point lead to advance to the District 2 Class 3A semifinals with a 51-35 win over Western Wayne on Tuesday night. item.title: LOCAL COLLEGE: King’s men take double OT thriller
item.description: Sean Forrest forced overtime, and the King’s College men’s basketball team found a way to pull out a double-overtime thriller. Forrest knotted the game with 29 seconds left in regulation off a Ben Rodner-Tims assist, and Ben Malley sealed the victory with 12 seconds left in double overtime as King’s held off DeSales, 98-97, in MAC Freedom play Tuesday night. item.title: Former 76ers coach, legendary character Doug Moe dies at 87
item.description: Doug Moe, an ABA original who gained fame over a rumpled, irreverent and sometimes R-rated decade as coach of the Denver Nuggets in the 1980s, died Tuesday. He was 87.
